info.syllabusName: Hệ thống thông tin trong kinh doanh (Information Systems in Business)
info.description:
The
subject provides an overview of the role of information technology (IT) and
information systems (IS) in organizations. It highlights technology
fundamentals and the trends that are shaping computing and communications.
Technology, when introduced into an organization, needs to be aligned with the
business context, and it is important to look at how IT systems can be built
and adopted in companies. Systems by themselves are building blocks of a
broader vision called the IT architecture. This architecture must be a part of
the overall IT strategy that also includes process changes and the
establishment of external value networks and virtual enterprises.

The
subject covers all key aspects of IT in organizations, including the
technological context, individual usage, enterprise applications, strategic
systems and external networks. This subject Information Systems for Business
discusses the key principles of successfully managing and using IT. This will
help you become a more effective either the role manager to deal with IT or the
role of end-user. Case studies will be used to illustrate the issues and
solutions.
